# Best 18650 chargers

**Best overall: XTAR VC4SL, about $32.90**
- It has four independent bays, USB-C with QC3.0 input, and adjustable current from 0.25A to 3A.
- Its screen shows voltage, current, capacity and internal resistance, and it has capacity-grading and storage modes.
- It fits protected 21700 cells and also charges NiMH/NiCd.
- Downsides: reviewers say it defaults to the highest current, so lower it for older or smaller cells. It can end NiMH charges early or mistake NiMH for Li-ion, so watch the start of a charge. It doesn't charge LiFePO4.
- [Buy / see price](https://us.best-batteries.com/reviews/xtar-vc4sl/). Reviews: [1Lumen](https://1lumen.com/battery-charger-review/xtar-vc4sl/), [Stephen Knight](https://www.stephenknightphotography.com/post/charger-review-xtar-vc4sl).

**Best for speed and LiFePO4: Nitecore UMS4, about $38.95**
- It charges up to 3A in one slot and has four independent slots.
- It supports Li-ion, LiFePO4 and NiMH, shows internal resistance and has a Li-ion restoration mode.
- It has reverse-polarity and short-circuit protection.
- [Price listing](https://us.best-batteries.com/reviews/xtar-vc4sl/) and [Nitecore specs](https://www.nitecore.com/mobile-product/ums4).

**Best simple multi-chemistry option: Keenstone 4-Bay Universal Charger**
- Smashing Robotics picked it as Editor's Choice. It has four independent bays, selectable 500mA or 1A current, and UL/CE/FCC marks.
- It was rated 4.6 stars across 4,608 reviews, according to that site.
- It has no capacity grading or internal-resistance testing.
- I don't have a price or a direct buy link for it. The [Smashing Robotics guide](https://www.smashingrobotics.com/best-18650-battery-chargers/) links to Amazon, and that site earns affiliate commissions.

**Budget pick: Tenergy TN270, $18.99**
- It's a basic 2-bay wall charger at 500mA per slot, so a 3,000mAh cell takes about 6–7 hours. It has no USB input.
- It comes with a 12-month warranty and 30-day returns.
- [Buy at Tenergy](https://dealectric.com/go/tenergy-tn270-li-ion-18650-charger). This is an affiliate link, so the retailer pays a commission at no cost to you. Details are on the [Dealectric page](https://dealectric.com/tenergy-tn270-li-ion-18650-charger).

**Which to choose**
- Most people should get the **XTAR VC4SL**.
- Choose the **Nitecore UMS4** if you charge LiFePO4 cells or want the fastest single-slot charging.
- Choose the **Tenergy TN270** if you just need a cheap charger for a flashlight or vape cells.

Whichever you buy, avoid no-name chargers that don't say how they decide a cell is full, and chargers that pair slots, as [VoltRated](https://voltrated.com/guides/best-chargers) advises. Prices are from the listings above and may have changed.
